'''Tamaron Pol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanthrym]]. He settled on [[Coyn]] and made a sport of avoiding the local security forces.
